lines.zh: 我走得不快，但你甩不掉。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, yet you cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在你身后几步。
lines.en: My steps stay a few paces behind you.
I can walk even under water.
I follow from the overworld elsewhere.
Each step makes the sky a little darker.
I do not run. I only go forward.
My shadow is longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，声音都没了。
lines.en: Where I step, the sound is gone.
All you can hear is me.

lines.zh: 我一步步靠近，很有耐心。
lines.en: I close in step by step, patiently.
I have walked this road before.

lines.zh: 我的脚印里没有温度，也不停。
lines.en: There is no warmth in my footprints, and I never stop.
I stand inside your dream.
I do not move. I only watch.
Something rattles under your bed.
While you sleep, I am here.
I am counting something.
Whispers come from inside the wall.
I do not eat, and I do not sleep.
Every door in this world is too thin.
I wait for you to turn your head.
The lamp will go out on its own.
I have been here a long while.
Someone is calling you from far off.

lines.zh: 你看见的这张脸，是借来的。
lines.en: The face you see is one I borrowed.
Your eyes are badly bloodshot.
You want to run, but your legs will not.
I remember the sound you made last night.
There is someone standing behind you too.
When you blink, I will be nearer.
I say your name very softly.
Do not look when I smile.
Your fingers are quivering.
The whispers you hear are mine.
I need no weapon.

lines.zh: 你床边那一块阴影，就是我。
lines.en: That shadow by your bed is me.
You never truly woke up.
Count to three, and I am there.
Just keep looking at me.
You hit me. And then?
I back half a step, then come on.
Blood runs from the corner of my mouth.
This body still moves.
You think this will help.
I bared my teeth.
The whispers got louder.
My figure flickered.
This is not the end.
I am saving my appetite.

lines.zh: 你把它举高，我还是看着你。
lines.en: Hold it high; I am still watching you.
I am hungry, but not for that.
Put it in your bag.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西对我没用。
lines.en: What you hold is useless to me.
Chasing you suits me better.
Your gaze drifted.
Put it down and walk away.
I am one step closer.
Do not look behind you.
I bump into you, very lightly.
Your skin went cold for a moment.
I am right behind you.
A door will not hold you either.
Your breath stopped for half a beat.
I slowly make room.
Do not find your footing.
I can hear your pulse.
There is no such thing as company.
I have only one purpose.
I do not listen to the whispers of my kind.
Farther is better.
I neither breed nor die.
Only you and I on this road.
Do not expect me to stay.
I will come again.
Killing me only delays it.
We will meet in the End.
In my hand it is like ice.
This has some use.
I set it down, and it vanishes.
Take it, if you want it.
It is turning black.
I crush it.
This is not yours.
Keep it, or give it to me.
Not worth noticing.
You took one step.

lines.zh: 低语的源头，就是你的名字。
lines.en: The source of the whispers is your name.
The whispering stopped.
I look your way.
This time I will not walk away.

lines.zh: 你听见墙里的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the sound in the wall.
I am coming over.
Doors will not hold me.
Water makes no difference.

lines.zh: 你把味道留在空气里了。
lines.en: You left your scent in the air.
Do not go to the Nether.
I go there too.
I will wait at the end of the End.
Run now.
I have counted to three.
This is the third time.
I hang behind you always.
You run into water, and I am there too.
You enter the Nether, and I follow.
You warp to the End, and I am already there.
Distance means nothing to me.
Look back, and there I am.
My steps stay with you.
You lock the door, and I push it open.
You are underwater, and so am I.
Walls do not stop me.

lines.zh: 我比你更熟悉这栋房子。
lines.en: I know this house better than you do.
You have changed places many times.
I have always been here.
The more you run, the more tired you get.
I am not tired at all.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我越知道你在哪。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the better I know where you are.
That shadow on the bed is mine.

lines.zh: 你听见身后的脚步了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the footsteps behind you.
Almost touching.
Do not stop your feet.
I tear down with a grasp.
You are thrown into the wall.
A fireball leaves my hand.
TNT drops at your feet.
You are thrown high into the air.
This time you land hard.
My marks are left on you.
I am close again.
You cannot block this.
I throw one small thing at you.
It has its teeth in you.
I can chase you even underwater.
You are still breathing.
I appear behind you.
The lamp in the room went out.
Whispers come out of the wall.
Your bed shifted.
I watch you from far away.
The air turned cold all at once.
The door opened by itself.
You should not have fallen asleep.
Having come, I will not leave.
A shadow rises on the water.
I am in the Nether's fire too.

lines.zh: 末地的石头上躺着我的影子。
lines.en: My shadow lies on the End stone.

lines.zh: 你听见指甲刮门的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear nails on the door.
I am not finished.
You can only delay me.
Only that dragon can finish me.
I approach one step at a time.
This night will be long.
I am at your door.
The fire burns my face, and I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，站得很稳。
lines.en: I land from a height and stand firm.
Underwater I walk as usual.
The blast scatters my shape.
The arrow goes through, and I feel little.
This light made me step back.
I am not hungry; I only slowed.
Lightning struck, and I stood straight.

lines.zh: 这里安静得连我都不习惯。
lines.en: It is quieter than even I am used to.
